rule: SHRINK-ONLY accessibility budget for the axe-core phase of the browser client tier (bun run test:client). required_surfaces: the named cataloguing surfaces the phase MUST mount (client/dedalo/test/client/js/a11y_surfaces.js) — a surface the run did not mount is RED, never silently skipped. The record surface is named FOUR times because a component group NESTS, because the shipped columns render NO label node (a flat wrapper cannot show a portal row giving every column the portal's name, and a nested row built with label NODES is a DOM the application never renders — all 14 view_line_edit_* pass label:null, which is the shape component_line_row builds), and because the ACTIVE state is its own surface: the inactive wrapper declares no background, so no static reading sees the label ink the field tint paints behind (component_edit_active mounts the same wrapper with the class ui.component.activate adds). The ROW box is named FIVE times (engineering/wire_contract/WC-2026-10-30-section-record-row-box.md), each filled by the real record window: a table row with its header (table > row header + rowgroup > row > cell), a list-layout row (list > listitem), a table over the window bound (aria-hidden placeholder rows beside the built ones, aria-rowcount / aria-rowindex), the zero-row table WITH a header (keeps role=table: the header is its row) and the zero-row table WITHOUT one (the window drops role=table, since a table owning no row fails aria-required-children). The login form is named because it is the first surface a curator meets and its fields were labelled only by a placeholder. The dialog is named THREE times because its accessibility contract differs per STATE and per declared modality: open+modal isolates the page, minimized (parked in the strip) must not, and a remove_overlay panel never does. violations: one entry per (surface, axe rule id) with the node count still tolerated and the reason it is. A violation over its budget is red; an UNBUDGETED violation is red; and a budgeted violation that no longer fires is red too, so an excuse cannot outlive the defect it names. Judged in scripts/lib/client_gate_verdict.ts (judgeAxe) through the same exit as every other client-gate verdict; guarded by test/unit/client_a11y_budget_tripwire.test.ts.
